systems.tiers: data offices at central and subnational levels; study of 53 offices across four countries, November 2022 to July 2024

note: Abstract only. It states that Ethiopia's electronic routine health information system runs on DHIS2 and that the function for calculating reports received against expected was available in 75.0% of Ethiopian data offices assessed, with visualisation gaps; these are software functionalities in data offices, not tiers in use, place of data entry or clinic coverage, so no fact is recorded.
